{"parentUuid":"2a0333ac-fb07-4000-b4b4-c1753bfce47e","isSidechain":false,"attachment":{"type":"skill_listing","content":"- update-config: Use this skill to configure the Claude Code harness via settings.json. Automated behaviors (\"from now on when X\", \"each time X\", \"whenever X\", \"before/after X\") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions (\"allow X\", \"add permission\", \"move permission to\"), env vars (\"set X=Y\"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Examples: \"allow npm commands\", \"add bq permission to global settings\", \"move permission to user settings\", \"set DEBUG=true\", \"when claude stops show X\". For simple settings like theme/model, suggest the /config command.\n- keybindings-help: Use when the user wants to customize keyboard shortcuts, rebind keys, add chord bindings, or modify ~/.claude/keybindings.json. Examples: \"rebind ctrl+s\", \"add a chord shortcut\", \"change the submit key\", \"customize keybindings\".\n- simplify: Review changed code for reuse, quality, and efficiency, then fix any issues found.\n- fewer-permission-prompts: Scan your transcripts for common read-only Bash and MCP tool calls, then add a prioritized allowlist to project .claude/settings.json to reduce permission prompts.\n- loop: Run a prompt or slash command on a recurring interval (e.g. /loop 5m /foo). Omit the interval to let the model self-pace. - When the user wants to set up a recurring task, poll for status, or run something repeatedly on an interval (e.g. \"check the deploy every 5 minutes\", \"keep running /babysit-prs\"). Do NOT invoke for one-off tasks.\n- schedule: Create, update, list, or run scheduled remote agents (routines) that execute on a cron schedule. - When the user wants to schedule a recurring remote agent, set up automated tasks, create a cron job for Claude Code, or manage their scheduled agents/routines. Also use when the user wants a one-time scheduled run (\"run this once at 3pm\", \"remind me to check X tomorrow\").\n- claude-api: Build, debug, and optimize Claude API / Anthropic SDK apps. Apps built with this skill should include prompt caching. Also handles migrating existing Claude API code between Claude model versions (4.5 → 4.6, 4.6 → 4.7, retired-model replacements).\nTRIGGER when: code imports `anthropic`/`@anthropic-ai/sdk`; user asks for the Claude API, Anthropic SDK, or Managed Agents; user adds/modifies/tunes a Claude feature (caching, thinking, compaction, tool use, batch, files, citations, memory) or model (Opus/Sonnet/Haiku) in a file; questions about prompt caching / cache hit rate in an Anthropic SDK project.\nSKIP: file imports `openai`/other-provider SDK, filename like `*-openai.py`/`*-generic.py`, provider-neutral code, general programming/ML.\n- ccs-delegation: Auto-activate CCS CLI delegation for deterministic tasks. Parses user input, auto-selects optimal profile (glm/kimi/custom) from ~/.ccs/config.json, enhances prompts with context, executes via `ccs {profile} -p \"task\"` or `ccs {profile}:continue`, and reports results. Triggers on \"use ccs [task]\" patterns, typo/test/refactor keywords. Excludes complex architecture, security-critical code, performance optimization, breaking changes.\n- crawler-reliability: Build reliable web crawlers for data gathering. Use when implementing scrapers for CafeF, NDH, VietnamBiz, YouTube (yt-dlp), Facebook fanpages, or any external data source. Covers Python/Playwright patterns, retry/backoff, selector robustness, rate limiting, monitoring.\n- ddd-tactical-patterns: Apply DDD tactical patterns (aggregate, entity, value object, repository, domain event, anti-corruption layer) correctly in Python/dataclasses code. Use when designing or implementing domain models, repositories, or cross-bounded-context communication in StockForge's 9 BCs.\n- evidence-extraction: Extract structured claims from unstructured sources with citation integrity. Use when building extraction pipelines, parsing news articles or KOL transcripts, or anywhere claims are created from raw data. Ensures every claim has source_url, extracted_at, confidence, and verified attribution. Enforces no-LLM-math invariant (I-S1).\n- fastapi-module: Implement FastAPI routers following StockForge conventions. Use when creating a new HTTP endpoint, adding routes, wiring dependency injection, configuring Pydantic DTOs. Covers router boundaries, provider patterns, testing setup. Phase 2+ only — Phase 1 uses Streamlit dashboard directly.\n- grill-maximization: Doctrine for bundling Q&A questions to the human at maximum density per turn (15-20 target, max 25), so each human-in-the-loop touchpoint is information-rich. Use when composing a Q&A bundle for human-workspace/q-and-a/pending/, or when deciding whether to ask one question or wait and bundle. Built on the principle that human-in-the-loop time is the scarcest resource in autonomous coding.\n- obsidian-vault: Search, create, and manage notes in the StockForge Obsidian vault with wikilinks, frontmatter, and index maintenance. Use when adding content to the knowledge base, navigating entities/concepts, or maintaining the raw/wiki separation. Adapted from mattpocock/skills, MIT licensed. Extended with raw/wiki pattern from Karpathy LLM Wiki.\n- postgres-pgvector: Design Postgres schemas with pgvector and TimescaleDB for StockForge. Use when creating migrations, designing tables, writing queries. Covers vector embeddings for semantic search on Vietnamese text, time-series for price/sentiment data, JSONB vs structured columns.\n- prompt-engineering: Design and optimize LLM prompts for StockForge pipeline stages. Use when writing or refining prompts for claim extraction, KOL recommendation extraction, sentiment analysis, thesis synthesis. Covers context assembly, prompt caching strategy, budget-aware prompts, structured output. Enforces no-LLM-math constraint.\n- qa-escalation: File-based Q&A protocol — composes bundle file in human-workspace/q-and-a/pending/, tracks lifecycle (pending → answered → stale → processed), creates URGENT notification when needed. Use when intent classifier recommends OPEN_QA_BUNDLE / ESCALATE_HUMAN, or grill-maximization has a bundle ready to write. Pairs with grill-maximization (composes content) + Track 5 hooks (auto-move stale).\n- spec-dual-layer: Write specifications with dual-layer structure (business narrative + agent contract). Use when authoring new specs, refining existing specs, or understanding the spec template. Ensures both human stakeholder needs and agent execution needs are served.\n- spec-to-wiki: Convert raw specifications to Obsidian wiki format with wikilinks, frontmatter, and index updates. Use when adding a new spec to the knowledge base, or when regenerating wiki view after spec changes. Maintains raw as source of truth, wiki as navigable view.\n- test-pyramid-balance: Balance unit, integration, and E2E tests properly in Python/pytest. Use when deciding what test to write, reviewing test coverage, or rebalancing skewed test suite. Covers test pyramid shape, BDD vs unit tests, when to use what. Includes stock-domain-specific test categories.\n- ubiquitous-language: Extract a DDD-style ubiquitous language glossary from the current conversation or domain area. Use when starting work on a new bounded context, when new domain terms emerge, or when verifying consistency between business language and code. Adapted from mattpocock/skills, MIT licensed.\n- user-prompt-intake: Hybrid intent classifier — main session lite-detects trivial prompts, dispatches intent-classifier subagent for complex ones. Use whenever a new user prompt lands (chat or file in human-workspace/user_prompt/) and you need to route the work. Built for full-autonomous loop where every prompt must be classified before action.\n- write-a-skill: Create new Claude Code skills with proper structure, progressive disclosure, and discoverability. Use when extracting a pattern from multiple sessions into a reusable skill, or when user asks to formalize a technique. {"parentUuid":"b3d4eef9-a534-424c-b874-8ffb753bcc35","isSidechain":false,"attachment":{"type":"nested_memory","path":"C:\\htdocs\\stockforge\\human-workspace\\CLAUDE.md","content":{"path":"C:\\htdocs\\stockforge\\human-workspace\\CLAUDE.md","type":"Project","content":"# human-workspace/ — Contract\n\n> **Audience**: agents reading anything inside `human-workspace/`.\n> **Established**: Decision 002 § Track 1 (Workspace Dualism Foundation).\n\n## Identity\n\n`human-workspace/` is the **human-authored authority** layer. Everything here represents **human decisions, scope, intent, and verification**. Agents READ this directory as authoritative; agents do NOT WRITE here except in one designated channel (`q-and-a/pending/` — where agents post questions for human to answer).\n\nThis separation exists because of a failure mode observed in the orch sister project (orch `decisions/040`, post-mortem CF-DOGFOOD-2): when human and agent share a single workspace without contract, agent silently overrides human-CRITICAL items via technical-defer logic. The user explicitly raised this concern in `human-workspace/user_prompt/20260429_02_init.txt` §1.1.\n\n---\n\n## Subdirectories\n\n| Path | Purpose | Who writes |\n|---|---|---|\n| `user_prompt/` | Human's mid-flight scope/idea drops. Naming: `YYYYMMDD_NN_<slug>.txt`. Files are immutable post-creation (audit trail). | **Human only**. Agent: read-only. |\n| `decisions/` | Human's strategic decisions (e.g., scope-lock, charter-revision-trigger, peer-share authorization). Format: `D-H-<NNN>-<slug>.md`. | **Human only**. Agent: read-only. |\n| `q-and-a/pending/` | **The ONE channel where agent writes inside human-workspace**. Agent drops Q&A bundles per Grill Maximization doctrine; human responds inline or moves to `answered/`. | **Both** (agent writes new bundles; human writes answers). |\n| `q-and-a/answered/` | Q&A bundles human has answered (with answers inline). Agent reads answers and acts. Archive forever; provenance trail. | **Human moves** (drag from `pending/`); agent reads. |\n| `q-and-a/stale/` | Pending bundles that exceeded their `expected_answer_by` (default 24h, urgent 4h). Auto-moved by SessionStart hook (Track 5). | **Hook moves**; both read. |\n| `notifications/` | Agent push to human — summaries, alerts, milestones. Format: `N-<TS>-<level>-<slug>.md`. Levels: INFO / SUMMARY / ALERT. | **Agent writes**; human reads. |\n\n---\n\n## Contract Rules (BINDING)\n\n1. **Agent NEVER writes to `user_prompt/` or `decisions/`.** Permission deny. If something feels like a human decision but the human hasn't written it, dispatch a Q&A bundle into `q-and-a/pending/` instead.\n\n2. **`user_prompt/` files are immutable post-creation.** Agent never deletes, renames, or edits these files. They are the audit trail of human interventions.\n\n3. **Q&A bundle format** (per Track 4 spec): YAML frontmatter (`id`, `topic`, `opened_at`, `expected_answer_by`, `priority`, `related_decisions`, `status`) + question body + answer-fill section. Each bundle = up to 25 questions per Grill Maximization doctrine; split if more.\n\n4. **Agent does not move files between `q-and-a/{pending,answered,stale}/`** — that's human's role (or hook's, in case of stale). Agent only WRITES new pending bundles and READS answers.\n\n5. **Notifications are read-only for human.** Human shouldn't edit `notifications/*` files; if disagreement with notification content, drop a `user_prompt/` instead. Notifications are the agent's account of events.\n\n6. **Provenance pointers**: every `agent-workspace/memory/decisions/D-<NNN>` should reference its source `human-workspace/user_prompt/<file>` or `human-workspace/decisions/D-H-<NNN>` if the agent's decision derives from human input.\n\n7. **No multi-tenancy in this directory.** Per identity-scope.md (Track 7), stockforge is single-tenant Phase 0-5; if peer share happens it's via git-fork, each peer has their own `human-workspace/` per fork.\n\n---\n\n## Reading Priority for Agent\n\nWhen loading session context (per `agent-workspace/constitution/autonomous-protocol.md` Track 7):\n\n1. **All `user_prompt/*.txt`** — every prompt, not just most recent. Per orch lesson (decision-040 USER-CRITICAL tier): never silently defer human-CRITICAL items.\n2. **All `decisions/*.md`** — human's strategic decisions are above charter principles in priority; charter is below human (charter was authored by human in the first place).\n3. **Latest `q-and-a/answered/*`** — recent answers update agent's understanding.\n4. **Open `q-and-a/pending/*`** — flag if waiting on human answers.\n5. **Recent `notifications/*`** (last 7 days) — for situational awareness.\n\n---\n\n## Agent Self-Check\n\nBefore writing to `human-workspace/q-and-a/pending/`, ask:\n- Is this question genuinely something the human must decide? (Charter principle / Charter-affecting / SCOPE-affecting / above ARCH-tier confidence threshold)\n- Have I already grilled this in a recent bundle? (Don't ask twice; don't pollute pending/)\n- Am I bundling per Grill Maximization (target 15-20 questions, max 25)? Or splintering across many small bundles?\n\nIf the answer to any is \"I'm not sure\" — DON'T write the bundle. Either answer it yourself with charter-principle reasoning + log decision, or wait until ambiguity clears.\n","contentDiffersFromDisk":false},"displayPath":"human-workspace\\CLAUDE.md"},"type":"attachment","uuid":"3960843a-5f18-4df4-b609-e9fbb6bb786b","timestamp":"2026-04-29T08:42:51.126Z","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"C:\\htdocs\\stockforge","sessionId":"c313ef26-6ab1-4307-82d7-6e679e9dcdb1","version":"2.1.122","gitBranch":"main"}

Everything here represents **agent state, decisions, plans, observations, learning**. Agents WRITE here freely (within constitution rules); humans READ here but normally do not edit.\n\nThis separation exists to prevent two failure modes from orch:\n1. **Charter drift via shared-workspace mutation** (orch CF-DOGFOOD-2)\n2. **Human cognitive overload from dense session logs** (UP02 §1.3 — \"human đối mặt hàng chục spec/document quá tải nếu không sắp xếp khoa học\")\n\nThe agent owns this directory but must keep it AUDITABLE — every artifact provenance-linked, every decision sourced.\n\n---\n\n## Subdirectories\n\n| Path | Purpose | Lifecycle |\n|---|---|---|\n| `constitution/` | **IMMUTABLE without explicit user approval**. Charter-tier rules (autonomous-protocol, model-routing, identity-scope, etc.). Track 7 produces drafts in `proposals/`; user explicit approve to move here. | Edit denied by .claude/settings.json; Write only via human approval gate |\n| `memory/project.md` | High-level project state; phase tracker; ADRs (last 5). Update on phase boundaries + architectural decisions. | Long-lived; trim to most recent decisions |\n| `memory/current-execution.md` | **THE single routing source of truth**. Active phase + active session + autonomous_mode flag + routing table. Read FIRST every session. | Long-lived; updated each session boundary |\n| `memory/agent-notes.md` | Learned rules from real experience (post-mortem / drift / user correction). Append-only mostly. | Long-lived |\n| `memory/decisions/` | Sequential ADRs (`NNN-<slug>.md`) + `_template.md` + `README.md` index. 12-field schema (Track 2). | Append-only; supersession via status field |\n| `memory/sessions/` | One file per session: `YYYY-MM-DD-session-N.md`. What happened, decisions made, files touched. | Append-only |\n| `memory/observations/` | Subagent return artifacts (per Track 6 spec). Each subagent writes one observation file describing what it did. | Append; cleaned periodically by aggregator |\n| `memory/checkpoints/` | Session handoff state for self-reboot (Track 5). `latest.md` is canonical pointer; timestamped historical files retained. | Append + latest.md updated each checkpoint |\n| `memory/patterns-discovered/` | Pattern mining outputs (Track 0 — DONE) + ongoing pattern catalog. | Append; significant patterns promoted to constitution |\n| `memory/drift-logs/` | Drift-check (DR1-DR12) results; runs on hook + on-demand. | Time-series append |\n| `memory/post-mortems/` | After significant failure or thesis-revoked event: what failed, root cause, prevention rule. | Append |\n| `memory/thesis-log/` | Stock-domain thesis exploration entries. Read-only for IMPL sessions. | Append + revisited per calibration |\n| `memory/sync-tracker/` | Track 8a output: Confidence Score SQLite + weights.yaml + auto-rendered `_index.md`. | Live updated by hooks |\n| `memory/self-awareness/` | Track 9 output: model × effort × thinking profile cards + known-issues + best-practices. | Live updated by Stop-hook aggregator |\n| `memory/mistake-log.md` | Track 7 deliverable: structured failure catalog. What went wrong / Root cause / Prevention rule / Severity. | Append; pre-flight read by all agents |\n| `session-plans/pending/` | Plans authored, awaiting execution. Phase 0 plan lives here. | Move to `completed/` when done |\n| `session-plans/completed/` | Executed plans; archived for reference + retrospective input. | Append |\n| `quality-reports/{deterministic,probabilistic,drift-reports}/` | Tier-1/2/3 gate outputs (CLAUDE.md § Quality Gates). | Per-run files |\n| `ubiquitous-language/` | DDD glossary + domain-mapping + drift-log. Stockforge stock-domain vocabulary. | Append; canonical via `/drill-me` |\n| `calibration/` | Empirical hit-rate data per signal type. Confidence claims MUST trace here (CLAUDE.md hard rule). | Append per thesis post-mortem |\n| `research/` | Research notes from `research-scanner` subagent dispatches (e.g., reference-repo studies). | Append |\n\n---\n\n## Contract Rules (BINDING)\n\n1. **Constitution is immutable absent explicit human approval.** `Edit/Write` to `agent-workspace/constitution/**` is in `.claude/settings.json` deny list. Track 7 writes constitution drafts to `proposals/`; user explicit approve moves them.\n\n2. **`memory/decisions/` is append-mostly + supersession-status.** Don't delete decisions; mark `status: superseded-by-D-NNN` to revoke. Sequential numbering (`001`, `002`, ...) — don't reuse numbers.\n\n3. **`current-execution.md` is the routing source-of-truth.** No skill, agent, or command may hardcode phase paths or session paths from memory; resolve via this file. Stale paths in CLAUDE.md or skills = anti-pattern.\n\n4. **Never edit `obsidian-vault/raw/`.** Immutable. Vault writes only to `wiki/`. (Established in stockforge CLAUDE.md.)\n\n5. **Provenance is mandatory.** Every decision file references its source (human prompt / spec clause / drift detection / agent inference). Every thesis cites source + as-of date (I-S2). Every confidence claim cites historical hit rate (I-S20-equivalent).\n\n6. **Agents never `git commit` in this directory unless user explicitly requests.** Stage only.\n\n7. **`patterns-discovered/` artifacts are READ-ONLY for production code.** Patterns must be promoted to constitution / skills / hook scripts before becoming binding. (Otherwise they're informal notes, not contracts.)\n\n---\n\n## Reading Priority for Agent\n\nPer `agent-workspace/constitution/autonomous-protocol.md` (Track 7) and stockforge `CLAUDE.md` § Session Protocol:\n\n1. **`memory/current-execution.md`** — first; resolve active track\n2. **`memory/project.md`** — project state\n3. **`memory/checkpoints/latest.md`** if a recent checkpoint exists (within last 24h) — resume context\n4. **`memory/agent-notes.md`** — learned rules\n5. **`memory/mistake-log.md`** — pre-flight failure catalog\n6. **Last 3 files in `memory/sessions/`** — recent context\n7. **`session-plans/pending/<active-plan>.md`** — current plan\n8. **Relevant constitution files** as task demands (don't load all every session)\n9. **Relevant skills + agents + commands** as task demands\n\n---\n\n## Anti-Patterns to Avoid\n\n(From `memory/patterns-discovered/SYNTHESIS.md` § 6, full catalog 23 items. Highest-priority for this directory:)\n\n- **AP-1 Same-agent self-review** — never review your own implementation; dispatch fresh-context verifier\n- **AP-2 Self-track wind-down** — `.transcript-tokens` real-transcript is authoritative, not LLM self-track\n- **AP-5 Charter-coherence defer overriding user-CRITICAL** — re-read all `user_prompt/*` at every phase entry; never silently defer USER-CRITICAL\n- **AP-7 Performative SC ticking** — defer with explicit prerequisites > fire vacuous proposals\n- **AP-8 Pre-staged work causing checkpoint drift** — update `current-execution.md` immediately on task complete, not session-end\n- **AP-17 Identity drift** — stockforge is AI-first VN stock advisory; not generic financial framework (see `constitution/identity-scope.md` once Track 7 ships)\n- **AP-23 Continuous LLM-Guardian** — deterministic hooks = Guardian; LLM Guardian only at session-end aggregation\n\n---\n\n## Connection to human-workspace/\n\nThis directory is the agent's domain. Human's domain is `human-workspace/`. The two communicate through:\n- Human → Agent: `human-workspace/user_prompt/`, `human-workspace/decisions/`\n- Agent → Human: `human-workspace/notifications/`, `human-workspace/q-and-a/pending/`\n- Bidirectional: `human-workspace/q-and-a/answered/` (agent writes pending; human moves answered)\n- Audit trail: this directory's `memory/decisions/` references `human-workspace/` source files via path pointers\n\nAgent never writes to `human-workspace/` outside the designated `q-and-a/pending/` channel.\n","contentDiffersFromDisk":false},"displayPath":"agent-workspace\\CLAUDE.md"},"type":"attachment","uuid":"4a07ae2e-0781-443b-bdf5-9c65233d15ab","timestamp":"2026-04-29T08:42:51.126Z","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"C:\\htdocs\\stockforge","sessionId":"c313ef26-6ab1-4307-82d7-6e679e9dcdb1","version":"2.1.122","gitBranch":"main"}

{"parentUuid":"d6dced14-4cf0-4b32-933d-3d3e3f28e989","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"8f71c52d-fd15-4938-99a9-a7c067b2831a","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01Ronu5hfJPzWtcsxrNiC23T","type":"tool_result","content":"1\t# Agent Notes — Learned Rules\n2\t\n3\t> Append-mostly. Each rule earned through real experience (post-mortem, drift detection, user correction).\n4\t> Rules here have higher status than convention but lower than constitution.\n5\t\n6\t## Rule Format\n7\t\n8\tUse this template:\n9\t\n10\t```markdown\n11\t### YYYY-MM-DD: [Short rule name]\n12\t**Context**: What situation triggered learning this\n13\t**Rule**: The actionable rule\n14\t**Anti-example**: What was done wrong\n15\t**Correct example**: What should be done instead\n16\t**Severity**: critical | high | medium | low\n17\t**Auto-detect**: yes/no — can a drift signal catch this?\n18\t```\n19\t\n20\t---\n21\t\n22\t## Initial Rules (from charter design)\n23\t\n24\t### 2026-04-23: LLM Never Outputs Numbers\n25\t**Context**: Stock domain risk — LLM-generated numbers in finance lead to real money loss\n26\t**Rule**: LLM never returns numerical values as natural-language output. All numbers come from deterministic Python functions invoked via tool use. LLM only interprets results.\n27\t**Anti-example**:\n28\t```\n29\tLLM output: \"Based on my analysis, the company's ROE is approximately 18%, P/E is around 12, and intrinsic value is roughly 95,000 VND per share.\"\n30\t```\n31\t**Correct example**:\n32\t```\n33\tLLM tool calls:\n34\t  compute_roe(net_income=2_345B, equity=13_120B) → 17.87%\n35\t  compute_pe(price=85_000, eps=7_054) → 12.05\n36\t  compute_intrinsic_value_dcf(...) → 94_523 VND\n37\tLLM output: \"ROE = 17.87% (FY2024), P/E = 12.05 (TTM), DCF intrinsic value = 94,523 VND. Versus current price 85,000 VND, suggests ~11% margin of safety.\"\n38\t```\n39\t**Severity**: critical\n40\t**Auto-detect**: yes — regex for \"approximately\", \"around\", \"roughly\" + numbers in LLM output\n41\t\n42\t### 2026-04-23: Bear Case Required for Every Thesis\n43\t**Context**: Confirmation bias is the #1 retail investor mistake\n44\t**Rule**: Every thesis output must include substantive bear case (≥3 distinct points, each grounded in evidence). System refuses to render thesis without it.\n45\t**Anti-example**: Thesis with bull case + risks section that says \"market volatility, regulatory changes\" (boilerplate)\n46\t**Correct example**: Bear case with specific points like \"Q3 inventory turnover dropped 23% YoY suggesting demand weakness\", \"Major competitor X launched directly competitive product Y in March 2026\", \"Net working capital deterioration of 15% indicates cash flow strain\"\n47\t**Severity**: high\n48\t**Auto-detect**: yes — bear case length + specificity check\n49\t\n50\t### 2026-04-23: Confidence Requires Calibration Data\n51\t**Context**: LLM \"confidence\" is qualitative; user reads numerical values\n52\t**Rule**: Any \"X% confidence\" or \"high/medium/low confidence\" claim must trace to historical hit rate from calibration database. Include `n_samples`, `lookback_period`, `hit_rate` metadata.\n53\t**Anti-example**: \"70% confidence this is a buy\"\n54\t**Correct example**: \"Confidence: MEDIUM (signal pattern: cyclical_bottom_with_dividend; historical n=23 cases since 2018; hit rate 65% over 12 months; lookback=78 months)\"\n55\t**Severity**: high\n56\t**Auto-detect**: partial — flag confidence claims without metadata\n57\t\n58\t### 2026-04-23: Source Provider Disagreement Surfaced\n59\t**Context**: vnstock vs FiinPro vs TCBS sometimes disagree on same data point\n60\t**Rule**: When sources disagree by >1%, output shows divergence explicitly. Never silently pick one.\n61\t**Anti-example**: \"Revenue Q3 2024: 35,000 tỷ\" (silent average or arbitrary pick)\n62\t**Correct example**: \"Revenue Q3 2024: 35,000 tỷ ± 200 tỷ (vnstock: 35,000 / FiinPro: 35,200 / TCBS: 34,800; reconciled with HIGH confidence)\"\n63\t**Severity**: medium\n64\t**Auto-detect**: no (requires source metadata in output template)\n65\t\n66\t---\n67\t\n68\t## Add New Rules Here\n69\t\n70\t### 2026-04-29: Q&A Bundle Skeleton MUST Carry `defer_cycle` Field\n71\t**Context**: While drafting `qa-escalation/references/sample-bundle.md` in S2, I initially omitted `defer_cycle` from the bundle frontmatter — caught on review against Decision 002 § Track 2 R7 mitigation.\n72\t**Rule**: Every Q&A bundle file in `human-workspace/q-and-a/pending/` MUST include `defer_cycle: 0` at creation, and increment on every reopening / supersession. Drift detection — có gì / thiếu gì\n\n**Có** (S3 vừa ship):\n- Deterministic hooks: `drift-signals-D1-D8.sh` (LOC/self-attest/charter-mixed/spec-dangling/missing-citation/LLM-math/no-bear-case/confidence-no-calib)\n- Semantic: `drift-detector` subagent, `/drift-check` command, `/ul-audit`, `charter-coherence-spot.sh`, `post-tool-citation-grep.sh`, `taskcompleted-audit.sh`\n- Lifecycle: `qa-pending-stale-mover`, `loc-ceiling-check`, `same-commit-rule`\n- Telemetry: `component-telemetry`, `session-export-raw`\n\n**Thiếu** (chính xác là cái UP-06 đang đặt ngón tay vào):\n- **Sync drift** — không có cơ chế đo \"human-LLM còn hiểu cùng một điều về *intent* của harness/scope không\"\n- **Intent-vs-implementation diff** — không có hook so plan/decisions/Q&A đã chốt với artifact thực tại để báo \"đã lệch khỏi UP-01..UP-06\"\n- **Periodic sync re-grilling** — không có auto-fire khi N sessions không có sync-check\n- **Cross-session drift comparison** — drift-signals chạy *trong* session, không so sánh giữa sessions\n\n### 2. Layer separation — có gì / thiếu gì\n\n**Có**: workspace dualism (`human-workspace/` vs `agent-workspace/`), constitution immutable, contracts (CLAUDE.md trong mỗi workspace)\n\n**Thiếu** (chính xác là cái UP-06 đặt câu hỏi):\n- Harness và Stockforge biz logic vẫn entangled (e.g., `evidence-extraction`, `postgres-pgvector`, `crawler-reliability` = project-specific; `qa-escalation`, `grill-maximization`, `write-a-skill` = portable; nhưng không có manifest phân loại)\n- Không có `/attach` skill để migrate harness sang dự án khác\n- Không có layer manifest (global/personal/committed/non-committed/harness/project)\n- Multi-tenant: 1 human khác cùng repo → conflict trong `human-workspace/`\n\n### 3. Self-upgrade / Self-test — có gì / thiếu gì\n\n**Có**: `agent-notes.md`, `patterns-discovered/`, `mistake-log` (S5 ship), telemetry hooks, Track 9 trong plan (S8 defer)\n\n**Thiếu**:\n- Skill \"deterministic-vs-LLM-probability decomposer\" — quan trọng nhất theo UP-06 §3\n- Capability-map (LLM tự biết được/không-được, nên/không-nên)\n- Karpathy autoresearch loop framework (try N approaches → measure → deepen → self-evolve)\n- Formal promotion path: `agent-notes` → `skill`/`hook`/`constitution`\n\n---\n\n## Reframe\n\n3 chiều UP-06 đều đổ về ý #1: **\"sync = backbone biến LLM thành second brain\"**. Layer separation và self-upgrade là *supporting infra* cho sync.\n\nNếu đồng ý, đề xuất chèn **Track 5.5 — Sync + Layer + Self-Capability Foundation** trước Track 6 (Track 6 sẽ adapt theo). Decisions are never deleted; they are marked `SUPERSEDED-BY-D-NNN` or `REVOKED` and remain on disk as the audit trail.\n8\t\n9\t---\n10\t\n11\t## Status Legend\n12\t\n13\t| Status | Meaning |\n14\t|---|---|\n15\t| `PROPOSED` | Authored by agent; awaiting user confirmation. Open Q&A bundle may exist. |\n16\t| `ACCEPTED` | User confirmed (via chat phrase, `user_prompt/` file, or `q-and-a/answered/` reply). Decision is binding. |\n17\t| `SUPERSEDED-BY-D-NNN` | A later decision replaced this one. Pointer in `superseded_by` field. The replacement decision's `supersedes` field points back. |\n18\t| `REVOKED` | Reversed without replacement. Triggers post-mortem (`agent-workspace/memory/post-mortems/`). 6-step protocol from Q&A A6 applies. |\n19\t\n20\tA decision may also carry `REV-N` amendments (in-place edits) — see [Amendments Convention](#amendments-convention) below.\n21\t\n22\t---\n23\t\n24\t## Decision Levels (per Q&A A4 thresholds)\n25\t\n26\t| Level | Confidence threshold to self-decide without Q&A | Examples |\n27\t|---|---|---|\n28\t| `CHARTER` | 0.99 | Identity scope, mission rewrite, autonomous mode activation |\n29\t| `SCOPE` | 0.90 | Phase plan, multi-track design, BC count, port-list scope |\n30\t| `ARCH` | 0.80 | Library choice, schema design, hook architecture |\n31\t| `IMPL` | 0.50 | File layout inside a track, naming, refactor pass |\n32\t\n33\tIf agent confidence is below threshold for a level, it MUST open a Q&A bundle in `human-workspace/q-and-a/pending/` rather than self-decide.\n34\t\n35\t---\n36\t\n37\t## Sequential Index\n38\t\n39\t> Newest first. Number is monotonic; never reused.\n40\t\n41\t| ID | Title | Level | Status | Date | Source prompt(s) |\n42\t|---|---|---|---|---|---|\n43\t| [D-002](002-phase-0-harness-bootstrap-design.md) | Phase 0 Harness Bootstrap Design (11 tracks) | SCOPE | ACCEPTED-REV-2 | 2026-04-29 | UP-01/02/03 |\n44\t| [D-001](001-orch-vs-cc-native.md) | Pause Orch, Port Patterns to StockForge | SCOPE | ACCEPTED | 2026-04-29 | UP-01 |\n45\t\n46\t---\n47\t\n48\t## Amendments Convention\n49\t\n50\tWhen a decision is **partially** revised after acceptance, the change is recorded **in-place** as `REV-N` (Q&A Q-S3 = A confirmed). D-002                              # AMENDED via REV-3 entry pointing here\n\ndepends_on:\n  - D-002                                # Phase 0 plan that this amends\n\nsupersedes: null\nsuperseded_by: null\n\ndefer_cycles: 0\nre_attempt_prereq: \"N/A — Track 5.5a starts S4 (next session).\"\n\ntags: [\"phase-0\", \"track-5.5\", \"sync\", \"layer\", \"self-capability\", \"karpathy\", \"scope-amendment\", \"up-06\"]\n---\n\n# Decision 003 — UP-06 Track 5.5 Insertion: Sync + Layer + Self-Capability Foundation\n\n> **Status**: ACCEPTED 2026-04-29 via 2x AskUserQuestion explicit picks.\n> **Amends**: D-002 Phase 0 design (insert Track 5.5 between Track 5 and Track 6).\n> **Q&A audit**: `human-workspace/q-and-a/answered/2026-04-29-004-up06-track-5.5-amendment.md`.\n\n---\n\n## Context\n\nUP-06 (`human-workspace/user_prompt/20260429_06.txt`) raised three strategic concerns and explicitly directed elevating \"sync\" to the #1 priority of the harness:\n\n1. **Drift detection coverage** — across (a) agent harness config/settings, (b) implementation process (plans, sessions, logs), (c) project (scope, spec, requirements). User specifically observed that \"sync questions\" between human-LLM about *intent* of harness configuration are missing.\n2. **Layer separation** — clear division between harness (reusable across projects), agent-workspace, human-workspace, project-specific. Foundation for \"context injection\" + portability (e.g., `/attach <new-project>`).\n3. **Self-upgrade / Self-test** — Karpathy autoresearch loop style: measure → trace → evaluate → improve. Specifically requires a skill/agent that decomposes work into \"deterministic\" vs \"LLM probability\" portions.\n\nUser-provided directive: **\"biến việc sync thành ưu tiên hàng đầu, giúp llm trở thành second brain thực sự.\"**\n\n### Audit at decision time (S3 close)\n\n**Drift detection — present**: D1-D8 hooks (S3 ship), `/drift-check`, `drift-detector` subagent, `/ul-audit`, `charter-coherence-spot.sh`, `post-tool-citation-grep.sh`, `taskcompleted-audit.sh`.\n\n**Drift detection — missing**:\n- \"Sync drift\" (human-LLM mutual understanding of harness intent)\n- Intent-vs-implementation semantic diff (UP-NN vs current artifacts)\n- Periodic auto-fired sync re-grilling (no \"you haven't asked me about X for N sessions\" trigger)\n- Cross-session drift comparison\n\n**Layer separation — present**: workspace dualism (`human-workspace/` vs `agent-workspace/`), constitution immutable, contracts.\n\n**Layer separation — missing**: harness vs stockforge biz logic still entangled in `.claude/`; no manifest; no `/attach` skill; no global/personal/committed/non-committed layer rules.\n\n**Self-upgrade — present**: `agent-notes.md`, `patterns-discovered/`, `mistake-log` (S5), telemetry hooks, Track 9 placeholder.\n\n**Self-upgrade — missing**: deterministic-vs-LLM decomposer skill, capability-map artifact, Karpathy autoresearch loop framework, formal promotion path (`agent-notes` → `skill`/`hook`/`constitution`).\n\n---\n\n## Decision\n\n**Insert Track 5.5 between Track 5 and Track 6 of D-002 Phase 0 plan, with three sub-tracks executed Layer → Sync → Self-Cap, then rewrite Track 6 based on the new layer manifest.**\n\n### Sub-track 5.5a — Layer Foundation (~150K, 1 session = S4)\n\n**Goals**:\n- Author `.claude/manifest.yaml` — schema declaring scope of each artifact (`harness` portable / `stockforge` biz-specific / `hybrid` / `personal` non-committed)\n- Directory restructure: move stockforge-biz skills/agents to `.claude/stockforge/` subtree; keep portable harness skills/agents/commands in `.claude/` root\n- Author `/attach` skill — copies harness layer (excluding `.claude/stockforge/`) to a target project path\n- Define layer rules: global (machine-wide) / personal (user-tagged, gitignored) / committed (in-repo) / non-committed (in-repo but gitignored)\n- **NOT multi-tenant** (per Round 2 Q6=D) — single human assumption; future peer-share via git-fork\n\n**Files affected**:\n- `.claude/manifest.yaml` (NEW)\n- `.claude/stockforge/skills/<biz-skill>/` (MOVE: candidates include `evidence-extraction`, `postgres-pgvector`, `crawler-reliability`, `fastapi-module`; final categorization happens in S4)\n- `.claude/skills/attach/SKILL.md` + `references/` (NEW)\n- `.gitignore` extended for personal/non-committed paths\n- `.claude/settings.json` permissions adjusted for new paths\n\n**Success**: manifest validates; restructured tree passes drift-signals-D1-D8 dry-run; `/attach` smoke-test copies harness to scratch dir + reproduces working CLAUDE.md skeleton.\n\n### Sub-track 5.5b — Sync Infrastructure (~300K, 2 sessions = S5+S6)\n\n**5.5b.1 — Intent-vs-Implementation Diff Agent (semantic, fresh-context)**\n- New subagent `.claude/agents/intent-vs-impl-diff.md`\n- Reads all `human-workspace/user_prompt/*.txt` + `agent-workspace/memory/decisions/*.md` + samples current artifacts\n- Produces `agent-workspace/memory/drift-logs/intent-impl-<TS>.md` listing: aligned / drifted-soft / drifted-hard items\n- Dispatched on-demand (mid-session) AND auto-dispatched at phase-boundary\n\n**5.5b.2 — Sync-State Artifact**\n- `agent-workspace/memory/sync-state.md` schema:\n  - `confirmed-aligned` items (confirmed-via-AskUserQuestion + date)\n  - `assumed-aligned` items (agent inferred but never explicitly verified)\n  - `open-question` items (queued in observations or pending Q&A)\n  - `drift-detected` items (from intent-vs-impl agent)\n- Updated by hooks + manual entries + intent-vs-impl agent output\n\n**5.5b.3 — Periodic Sync-Grilling Hook**\n- `scripts/hooks/sync-grilling-trigger.sh` (SessionStart hook)\n- Reads `last_sync_check` timestamp; if N sessions or M days elapsed → emit notification → agent fires AskUserQuestion sync-check next turn\n- Threshold values configurable via `STOCKFORGE_SYNC_GRILL_INTERVAL_SESSIONS` env (default 3) and `_DAYS` (default 7)\n\n**5.5b.4 — Sync-Specialized Q&A Template**\n- `.claude/skills/grill-maximization/references/sync-bundle-template.md`\n- Differs from feature/scope grills: questions phrased as \"do we still understand X the same way?\" not \"what should we do about X?\"\n- Pairs with grill-maximization SKILL.md's bundle composer\n\n**Success**: intent-vs-impl agent run on current state produces ≤5 drifted-hard items (proving early UP-NN alignment); sync-state.md populated with ≥20 entries; periodic-grilling hook fires successfully on dry-run with mock state.\n\n### Sub-track 5.5c — Self-Capability + Karpathy Autoresearch Full (~400K, 2-3 sessions = S7+S8)\n\n**5.5c.1 — `decompose-work` Skill (deterministic-vs-LLM-probability decomposer)**\n- New skill `.claude/skills/decompose-work/SKILL.md`\n- Input: task description (free-form)\n- Output: structured analysis listing parts that are deterministic (script/hook/code) vs parts requiring LLM (reasoning/creative/judgment), plus integration plan\n- Pairs with capability-map.md to inform \"what LLM is good at vs not\"\n\n**5.5c.2 — `capability-map.md` Artifact**\n- `agent-workspace/memory/capability-map.md`\n- Living document: LLM strengths/limits per dimension (model × effort × task_class)\n- Updated via promotion path: `agent-notes.md` entry → similarity-grouped → promoted to capability-map\n- Read by `decompose-work` skill at decomposition time\n\n**5.5c.3 — `try-n-approaches` Skill (Karpathy autoresearch loop)**\n- New skill `.claude/skills/try-n-approaches/SKILL.md`\n- Pattern: given a task, generate N approaches → evaluate via measurement framework → deepen most promising → loop\n- Horizontal scaling (N parallel approaches via subagent dispatch) + vertical scaling (loop-deepen the best)\n\n**5.5c.4 — OTEL Stack (formal traces)**\n- `docker/otel-stack/docker-compose.yml` (collector + simple Jaeger or local file exporter)\n- `packages/observability/otel_emitter.py` for instrumented Python code\n- Hook integration: `component-telemetry.sh` extended to emit OTEL traces in addition to JSONL\n\n**5.5c.5 — JSONL Telemetry Schema Extension**\n- Extend `scripts/hooks/component-telemetry.sh` JSONL output with new fields: `task_id`, `approach_id`, `metric`, `outcome`\n- Schema document at `agent-workspace/memory/self-awareness/jsonl-schema.md`\n\n**5.5c.6 — Promotion Path Formalization**\n- New skill `.claude/skills/promote-rule/SKILL.md` (or hook + agent combo)\n- Reads `agent-notes.md` periodically; clusters similar entries; proposes promotion to skill/hook/constitution per Q-E3 priority (hook first, skill second, charter last)\n\n**Success**: `decompose-work` smoke-test on a real Phase 0 task produces correct deterministic-vs-LLM split; `try-n-approaches` runs 3 parallel subagents on a thesis-exploration test case; OTEL traces visible in collector; capability-map.md has ≥10 seed entries from existing agent-notes; promotion path runs dry-run identifying ≥3 promotable rules.\n\n### Track 6 — REWRITE (post-5.5, 1 session = S9)\n\n**Original scope unchanged**: Discipline Skills + Subagents Port (B-14 from orch) + progressive-disclosure refactor of 12 existing skills + 13 commands (24 D1 LOC violations).\n\n**Adjustment**: skills/subagents/commands now categorized by `manifest.yaml` (5.5a). New subagents from 5.5b (intent-vs-impl-diff) and 5.5c (decompose-work paired agent if needed) integrated. The progressive-disclosure refactor target list may shift if 5.5a moves files into `.claude/stockforge/`.\n\n---\n\n## Budget Delta\n\n| Phase 0 segment | REV-2 estimate | REV-3 estimate (this) |\n|---|---|---|\n| Tracks 0-5 (already shipped through S3) | ~470K | ~470K (actuals) |\n| **Track 5.5a** Layer | — | **~150K** (NEW) |\n| **Track 5.5b** Sync (2 sessions) | — | **~300K** (NEW) |\n| **Track 5.5c** Self-Cap full (2-3 sessions) | — | **~400K** (NEW) |\n| Track 6 (skills+subagents port + refactor) | ~200K | ~150K (rewrite scope-aware via 5.5a) |\n| Track 7 (constitution port + CLAUDE.md) | ~150K | ~150K |\n| Track 8a (Confidence Score) | ~120K | ~120K |\n| Track 8b (Memory L0/L1 extraction) | ~120K | ~120K |\n| Track 9 (Self-Awareness + OTEL — overlap with 5.5c) | ~120K | ~80K (reduced — 5.5c covers OTEL setup) |\n| Final verifier S-final | ~80K | ~80K |\n| **TOTAL** | **~1.28M** | **~2.02M** |\n\nUser accepted \"~1.5-2M total\" via Round 2 Q8=A. Estimate lands at ~2.02M; within accepted band.\n\n---\n\n## Why (Reasons)\n\n1. **UP-06 §1 directive elevation of sync is binding** (UP-NN files have higher priority than charter principles per `agent-workspace/CLAUDE.md` Reading Priority — \"decisions/*.md are above charter principles\").\n\n2. **Layer-first sequencing reduces refactor cost** — Track 6 (skills port) lands cleanly after manifest exists; otherwise skills move twice (once into `.claude/`, once again into `.claude/stockforge/`).\n\n3. **Sync 4-mechanism ensemble is defense-in-depth** — periodic grilling catches scheduled drift; intent-diff agent catches semantic drift; sync-state.md provides single-source-of-truth audit; sync Q&A template ensures questions are well-formed for \"understanding\" vs \"implementation\". Single mechanism would leave gaps.\n\n4. **Aggressive Karpathy autoresearch matches stockforge mission** — financial advisory requires multi-perspective + measurement-driven calibration (charter principles). The autoresearch loop framework operationalizes both.\n\n5. **OTEL+JSONL hybrid provides scale headroom** — JSONL alone suffices for current scale; OTEL adds standard tooling for future externalization (peer-share, cloud telemetry). Cost is ~200K one-time setup vs forever-locked-in custom.\n\n6. **Multi-tenant explicitly skipped** to avoid scope creep. `/attach` covers project portability; if peer-share happens later, git-fork single-tenant pattern remains cleanest.\n\n---\n\n## Risks & Mitigations\n\n| Risk | Likelihood | Mitigation |\n|---|---|---|\n| Track 5.5 budget overshoots ~2M | Medium | Per-session budget watchdog (Track 5 hook) auto-reboots at 80% cliff. If 5.5c overshoots, descope c.4 OTEL to \"design-only\" + defer collector docker to Track 9. |\n| Layer manifest 5.5a gets entire restructure wrong → cascading rework | Medium | Smoke-test `/attach` on scratch dir BEFORE moving any production skill; sandwich-verifier dispatch (fresh ctx) on manifest before S5 starts. |\n| Sync grilling hook fires too often (annoying) | Low | Configurable threshold; default 3 sessions OR 7 days OR explicit user \"sync now\" command. Easy to tune. |\n| Karpathy autoresearch over-engineered for current scale | Medium | Start with `try-n-approaches` skill smoke-test on real task; if signal weak, descope OTEL to design-doc-only. |\n| Multi-tenant skip creates future regret if peer-share happens | Low | Documented escape hatch: git-fork single-tenant remains valid pattern; revisit if peer-share materializes (unlikely Phase 0-5). |\n| 5.5c overlap with Track 9 self-awareness creates duplicate work | Low | Track 9 budget reduced to 80K (was 120K) reflecting 5.5c absorbs OTEL setup. Track 9 retained for live profile cards + aggregator hook (separate concern). |\n\n---\n\n## Open Questions\n\nNone blocking S4 start. Decisions are never deleted; they are marked `SUPERSEDED-BY-D-NNN` or `REVOKED` and remain on disk as the audit trail.\n\n---\n\n## Status Legend\n\n| Status | Meaning |\n|---|---|\n| `PROPOSED` | Authored by agent; awaiting user confirmation. Open Q&A bundle may exist. |\n| `ACCEPTED` | User confirmed (via chat phrase, `user_prompt/` file, or `q-and-a/answered/` reply). Decision is binding. |\n| `SUPERSEDED-BY-D-NNN` | A later decision replaced this one. Pointer in `superseded_by` field. The replacement decision's `supersedes` field points back. |\n| `REVOKED` | Reversed without replacement. Triggers post-mortem (`agent-workspace/memory/post-mortems/`). 6-step protocol from Q&A A6 applies. |\n\nA decision may also carry `REV-N` amendments (in-place edits) — see [Amendments Convention](#amendments-convention) below.\n\n---\n\n## Decision Levels (per Q&A A4 thresholds)\n\n| Level | Confidence threshold to self-decide without Q&A | Examples |\n|---|---|---|\n| `CHARTER` | 0.99 | Identity scope, mission rewrite, autonomous mode activation |\n| `SCOPE` | 0.90 | Phase plan, multi-track design, BC count, port-list scope |\n| `ARCH` | 0.80 | Library choice, schema design, hook architecture |\n| `IMPL` | 0.50 | File layout inside a track, naming, refactor pass |\n\nIf agent confidence is below threshold for a level, it MUST open a Q&A bundle in `human-workspace/q-and-a/pending/` rather than self-decide.\n\n---\n\n## Sequential Index\n\n> Newest first. Number is monotonic; never reused.\n\n| ID | Title | Level | Status | Date | Source prompt(s) |\n|---|---|---|---|---|---|\n| [D-002](002-phase-0-harness-bootstrap-design.md) | Phase 0 Harness Bootstrap Design (11 tracks) | SCOPE | ACCEPTED-REV-2 | 2026-04-29 | UP-01/02/03 |\n| [D-001](001-orch-vs-cc-native.md) | Pause Orch, Port Patterns to StockForge | SCOPE | ACCEPTED | 2026-04-29 | UP-01 |\n\n---\n\n## Amendments Convention\n\nWhen a decision is **partially** revised after acceptance, the change is recorded **in-place** as `REV-N` (Q&A Q-S3 = A confirmed). The decision's `status` field becomes e.g. `ACCEPTED-REV-2`, and a new section `## Amendments` accumulates change history.\n\nWhen a decision is **wholly** replaced, do NOT amend — author a new decision file `D-NNN` with `supersedes: D-MMM`, and set the original's `status: SUPERSEDED-BY-D-NNN` and `superseded_by: D-NNN`.\n\nRule of thumb:\n- ≤30% content change, scope/intent unchanged → amend in-place (REV-N)\n- > 30% content change, or scope/intent changed → new decision file with supersedes pointer\n\n---\n\n## Naming Convention\n\n`<NNN>-<kebab-case-slug>.md` where `NNN` is zero-padded 3-digit (`001`, `002`, ... `999`).\n\nSlug rules:\n- ≤ 60 chars\n- Lower-case ASCII + hyphens only\n- Verb-leading when describing a change (`pause-orch`, `split-track-8`); noun-leading when describing a system (`provenance-protocol`, `confidence-score-system`)\n\n---\n\n## Provenance Discipline (binding)\n\nEvery decision MUST cite its `source_evidence`. An empty `source_evidence: []` triggers a drift-detector flag (`DR-PROV` — to be wired in Track 5 hooks).\n\nAcceptable source types:\n1. `human-workspace/user_prompt/<file>.txt` — user's explicit direction\n2. `human-workspace/decisions/<file>.md` — user's strategic decision\n3. `human-workspace/q-and-a/answered/<file>.md` — user's reply to Q&A bundle\n4. `agent-workspace/memory/patterns-discovered/*.md` — pattern mining result\n5. `agent-workspace/memory/post-mortems/<file>.md` — failure-driven learning\n6. `agent-workspace/memory/drift-logs/<file>.md` — drift signal evidence\n7. `specs/**/*.md` — formal spec clause\n8. Charter section reference (`PROJECT_CHARTER.md § X.Y`)\n\nDecisions that derive from agent inference alone (no upstream evidence) MUST tag `level: IMPL` AND state inference chain in `chosen_rationale`.\n\n---\n\n## R7 Mitigation: Defer-Cycle Tracking\n\nPer Decision 002 REV-2 § C R7 (msmdp Decision Provenance Chain pattern):\n\n- Each time a decision is paused, postponed, or rolled forward, increment `defer_cycles` by 1.\n- `defer_cycles > 3` → drift-detector raises alert; human Q&A bundle required to either commit or revoke.\n- `re_attempt_prereq` documents what must change before the decision can be resumed (e.g. \"blocker on D-XYZ resolution\", \"user feedback on Q-S5\", \"telemetry data after 1 month\").\n\nThis prevents the **can-kicking** anti-pattern observed during ms-mdp-admin Phase 2 workflow review.\n\n---\n\n## Reading Order for New Agents\n\n1. This file (overview + legend)\n2. [_template.md](_template.md) (canonical schema)\n3. Latest 5 decisions, newest first\n4. Any decision referenced by `current-execution.md` \"Routing Table\"\n\nFor provenance audits or drift checks: use the `source_evidence` graph — start from a recent decision, traverse backward via `depends_on` and forward via `superseded_by`.\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":40,"oldLines":7,"newStart":40,"newLines":8,"lines":[" "," | ID | Title | Level | Status | Date | Source prompt(s) |"," |---|---|---|---|---|---|","-| [D-002](002-phase-0-harness-bootstrap-design.md) | Phase 0 Harness Bootstrap Design (11 tracks) | SCOPE | ACCEPTED-REV-2 | 2026-04-29 | UP-01/02/03 |","+| [D-003](003-up06-track-5.5-sync-layer-selfcap.md) | UP-06 Track 5.5 — Sync + Layer + Self-Capability Foundation | SCOPE | ACCEPTED | 2026-04-29 | UP-06 |","+| [D-002](002-phase-0-harness-bootstrap-design.md) | Phase 0 Harness Bootstrap Design (11 tracks + Track 5.5) | SCOPE | ACCEPTED-REV-3 | 2026-04-29 | UP-01/02/03/06 |"," | [D-001](001-orch-vs-cc-native.md) | Pause Orch, Port Patterns to StockForge | SCOPE | ACCEPTED | 2026-04-29 | UP-01 |"," "," ---"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"a67b50e3-7c1b-4a8b-9866-3d6b92c678e3","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"C:\\htdocs\\stockforge","sessionId":"c313ef26-6ab1-4307-82d7-6e679e9dcdb1","version":"2.1.122","gitBranch":"main"}

5.5b.1 — Intent-vs-Implementation Diff Agent (S5, ~80K)\n\n**File**: `.claude/agents/intent-vs-impl-diff.md` (opus, fresh-context)\n\n**Mandate**:\n- Input: nothing (subagent reads files directly)\n- `agent-workspace/memory/drift-logs/intent-impl-<TS>.md` with 3-tier classification\n  - **aligned**: explicit user-stated intent matches current artifact\n  - **drifted-soft**: intent partially addressed; gap exists but not contradicting\n  - **drifted-hard**: artifact contradicts user intent (silent absorption / scope creep / direct violation)\n\n**Dispatch triggers**:\n- On-demand via sync-check\"\n- Do NOT auto-fire AskUserQuestion (per UP-05 — Skill/Ask tool autonomous-mode policy: only SUPERVISED mode fires)\n\n**Settings.json wiring**: add to `hooks.SessionStart` array\n\n#### 5.5b.4 — Sync-Specialized Q&A Template (S6, ~80K)\n\n**File**: `.claude/skills/grill-maximization/references/sync-bundle-template.md`\n\n**Differs from feature/scope grill**:\n- Questions phrased as \"do we still understand X the same way?\" not \"what should we do?\"\n- Each question references `sync-state.md` item ID\n- Multi-batch protocol: 4 questions per Ask call\n- Output: updates — Self-Capability + Karpathy Autoresearch Full (S7+S8, ~400K)\n\n**Goal**: Build full Karpathy autoresearch loop infrastructure per UP-06 §3.\n\n#### 5.5c.1 — `decompose-work` Skill (S7, ~80K)\n\n**File**: `.claude/skills/decompose-work/SKILL.md` + `references/`\n\n**Mandate**:\n- Input: free-form task description\n- Output: structured analysis\n  - **Deterministic portions**: list of sub-tasks doable via script/hook/code (no LLM judgment)\n  - **LLM-required portions**: sub-tasks requiring reasoning, creativity, judgment\n  - **Integration plan**: how the portions combine (sequence, data flow, escalation rules)\n\n**Reads `capability-map.md`** at decomposition time to ground \"what LLM is good at vs not\".\n\n#### 5.5c.2 — `capability-map.md` (S7, ~40K)\n\n**File**: task_class: [refactor, design, verification, extraction, synthesis, calibration, ...]\nstrengths_observed:\n  - {model: opus-4.7, task_class: design, effort: high, observation: \"...\", source: agent-notes-YYYY-MM-DD}\nlimits_observed:\n  - {model: opus-4.7, task_class: math, observation: \"I-S1: NO LLM math; deterministic always\", source: charter}\n```\n\n**Seeded from**:\n- existing ~80K)\n\n**File**: `.claude/skills/promote-rule/SKILL.md` (or hybrid hook+agent)\n\n**Mandate**:\n- Periodic: scan `agent-notes.md`; cluster similar entries (semantic similarity ≥0.7)\n- Cluster of ≥3 `agent-workspace/memory/observations/promotion-proposals-<TS>.md`\n\n#### 5.5c.3 — `try-n-approaches` Skill (S8, ~80K)\n\n**File**: `.claude/skills/try-n-approaches/SKILL.md`\n\n**Pattern**:\n- Given a task + N (default 3)\n- Generate N distinct approaches (different framings, tools, decompositions)\n- Dispatch N subagents in parallel (`run_in_background: true`)\n- Each approach has measurement metric defined upfront\n- Compare results → select best → loop-deepen with refined understanding\n\n**Horizontal scaling**: parallel approach exploration\n**Vertical scaling**: loop-deepen the best approach\n\n#### 5.5c.4 — OTEL Stack (S8, ~70K)\n\n**Files**:\n- `docker/otel-stack/docker-compose.yml` (single-container `grafana/otel-lgtm:1.4.0` per Q-S4 confirm)\n- Three sub-tracks executed Layer→Sync→Self-Cap, then rewrite Track 6 layer-aware.\n\nThis file is the **executable session-plan view** for Track 5.5 specifically. D-003 is the **strategic rationale**.\n\n---\n\n## Track 5.5 Success Criteria (whole)\n\nTrack 5.5 is COMPLETE when ALL of these hold:\n\n- [ ] **5.5a Layer**: `.claude/manifest.yaml` validates; harness/stockforge separation passes drift dry-run; `/attach` smoke-test succeeds on scratch dir\n- [ ] **5.5b Sync (4 mechanisms)**:\n  - [ ] `intent-vs-impl-diff` subagent dispatchable; produces drift-log on current state with ≤5 hard-drift items\n  - [ ] `agent-workspace/memory/sync-state.md` populated with ≥20 confirmed/assumed/open entries\n  - [ ] `sync-grilling-trigger.sh` hook fires correctly on dry-run (mock state >threshold)\n  - [ ] `grill-maximization/references/sync-bundle-template.md` exists + tested with sample sync questions\n- [ ] **5.5c Self-Cap (Karpathy full)**:\n  - [ ] `decompose-work` skill smoke-tests on real Phase 0 task with correct deterministic-vs-LLM split\n  - [ ] `capability-map.md` seeded with ≥10 entries from existing agent-notes\n  - [ ] `try-n-approaches` skill smoke-tests with 3 parallel subagent dispatch on test case\n  - [ ] OTEL stack: `docker-compose up` brings collector live + Python emitter pushes traces\n  - [ ] JSONL extension: `component-telemetry.sh` writes new schema fields; sample run logged\n  - [ ] Promotion path: dry-run identifies ≥3 promotable agent-notes rules\n\n---\n\n## Session Breakdown (5 sessions S4-S8)\n\n| # | Session | Sub-track | Type | Budget | Deliverables |\n|---|---|---|---|---|---|\n| **S4** NEXT | Layer Foundation | **5.5a** | FOCUSED_IMPL | ~150K | manifest.yaml + .claude/stockforge/ subtree + /attach skill |\n| S5 | Sync Part 1 | **5.5b.1+5.5b.2** | FOCUSED_IMPL | ~150K | intent-vs-impl-diff agent + sync-state.md schema |\n| S6 | Sync Part 2 | **5.5b.3+5.5b.4** | FOCUSED_IMPL | ~150K | sync-grilling-trigger hook + sync-bundle-template |\n| S7 | Self-Cap Part 1 | **5.5c.1+5.5c.2+5.5c.6** | FOCUSED_IMPL | ~200K | decompose-work skill + capability-map.md + promote-rule skill |\n| S8 | Self-Cap Part 2 | **5.5c.3+5.5c.4+5.5c.5** | MULTI_TASK_IMPL | ~200K | try-n-approaches skill + OTEL stack + JSONL extension |\n\nAfter S8 → S9 = Track 6 REWRITE (skills/subagents port layer-aware) per D-002 REV-3 § D.\n\n---\n\n## Sub-track Detail\n\n### 5.5a — Layer Foundation (S4, ~150K)\n\n**Goal**: Establish layer manifest + directory structure that separates harness (portable) from stockforge biz logic, enabling /attach skill to migrate harness alone to a new project.\n\n**Deliverables**:\n1. **`.claude/manifest.yaml`** — declares scope of every artifact:\n   ```yaml\n   version: 1\n   layers:\n     harness:                  # portable across projects\n       - .claude/skills/qa-escalation/\n       - .claude/skills/grill-maximization/\n       - .claude/skills/write-a-skill/\n       - .claude/skills/user-prompt-intake/\n       - .claude/skills/ubiquitous-language/\n       - .claude/skills/spec-dual-layer/\n       - .claude/skills/test-pyramid-balance/\n       - .claude/skills/ddd-tactical-patterns/\n       - .claude/skills/prompt-engineering/\n       - .claude/skills/obsidian-vault/\n       - .claude/skills/spec-to-wiki/\n       - .claude/skills/attach/   # NEW\n       - .claude/agents/sandwich-architect.md\n       - .claude/agents/sandwich-dev.md\n       - .claude/agents/sandwich-verifier.md\n       - .claude/agents/spec-author.md\n       - .claude/agents/master-planner.md\n       - .claude/agents/devils-advocate.md\n       - .claude/agents/drift-detector.md\n       - .claude/agents/intent-classifier.md\n       - .claude/agents/ul-auditor.md\n       - .claude/agents/bdd-planner.md\n       - .claude/agents/action-guide-planner.md\n       - .claude/commands/  (most are dual-use; final categorization in S4)\n       - scripts/hooks/ (most are dual-use; categorize per file)\n     stockforge:                # biz-specific; stays in fork\n       - .claude/skills/evidence-extraction/\n       - .claude/skills/postgres-pgvector/\n       - .claude/skills/crawler-reliability/\n       - .claude/skills/fastapi-module/\n       - PROJECT_CHARTER.md\n       - specs/\n       - eval-sets/\n       - obsidian-vault/\n     hybrid:                    # parameterized by manifest swap\n       - CLAUDE.md\n     personal:                  # gitignored; user-tagged\n       - .claude/personal/\n   policies:\n     attach_excludes:\n       - .claude/stockforge/\n       - .claude/personal/\n       - PROJECT_CHARTER.md\n       - obsidian-vault/\n       - specs/\n       - eval-sets/\n       - agent-workspace/\n       - human-workspace/\n   ```\n2. **Directory restructure**: move 4 stockforge-biz skills (`evidence-extraction`, `postgres-pgvector`, `crawler-reliability`, `fastapi-module`) from `.claude/skills/` to `.claude/stockforge/skills/`. Update Glob references in code/docs.\n3. **`.claude/skills/attach/SKILL.md`** + `references/`:\n   - Input: target project path + (optional) flags `--include-personal` / `--dry-run`\n   - Reads manifest.yaml; copies harness layer (excluding stockforge + personal) to target\n   - Writes new `CLAUDE.md` skeleton + manifest.yaml at target\n   - Smoke-test: copy to scratch dir, verify skeleton functional\n4. **`.gitignore`** extended for personal/ paths\n5. **`.claude/settings.json`** permissions adjusted for new paths\n\n**Risks**:\n- Skill move breaks references → mitigation: grep for skill paths before move; sandwich-verifier dispatch on manifest before commit\n- /attach overwrites target's existing CLAUDE.md → mitigation: --dry-run default; --force flag explicit\n\n**Success**:\n- manifest.yaml validates against schema (write schema validator inline)\n- 4 stockforge-biz skills moved; SKILL.md cross-refs updated\n- /attach smoke-test passes on scratch dir\n- D1 drift-signal hook still passes (LOC ceilings respected)\n\n---\n\n### 5.5b — Sync Infrastructure (S5+S6, ~300K)\n\n**Goal**: Build 4-mechanism sync ensemble per UP-06 directive #1.\n\n#### 5.5b.1 — Intent-vs-Implementation Diff Agent (S5, ~80K)\n\n**File**: `.claude/agents/intent-vs-impl-diff.md` (opus, fresh-context)\n\n**Mandate**:\n- Input: nothing (subagent reads files directly)\n- Reads: all `human-workspace/user_prompt/*.txt` + all `agent-workspace/memory/decisions/*.md` + samples of current artifacts (skills, hooks, settings)\n- Produces: `agent-workspace/memory/drift-logs/intent-impl-<TS>.md` with 3-tier classification\n  - **aligned**: explicit user-stated intent matches current artifact\n  - **drifted-soft**: intent partially addressed; gap exists but not contradicting\n  - **drifted-hard**: artifact contradicts user intent (silent absorption / scope creep / direct violation)\n\n**Dispatch triggers**:\n- On-demand via `/intent-diff` command (NEW)\n- Auto-dispatched at phase-boundary (post-Phase-0 verifier session)\n\n#### 5.5b.2 — Sync-State Artifact (S5, ~70K)\n\n**File**: `agent-workspace/memory/sync-state.md`\n\n**Schema**:\n```yaml\nitems:\n  - id: sync-001\n    statement: \"Phase 0 = Harness Bootstrap, 11+5.5 tracks, supervised until Track 7\"\n    state: confirmed-aligned\n    confirmed_at: 2026-04-29T16:30:00+07:00\n    confirmation_via: AskUserQuestion (D-003 Round 1+2)\n    related_decisions: [D-002, D-003]\n  - id: sync-002\n    statement: \"...\"\n    state: assumed-aligned\n    last_check: 2026-04-29\n    assumption_basis: \"agent inference from UP-02 §1.1 — never explicitly verified\"\n  - id: sync-003\n    statement: \"...\"\n    state: open-question\n    queued_at: 2026-04-29\n    queue_ref: queued-grill-master.md § Q-X\n```\n\n**Update sources**:\n- Hook on `Write(human-workspace/q-and-a/answered/**)` → mark items confirmed\n- Hook on intent-vs-impl-diff agent output → flag drifted items\n- Manual entries via `/sync-add` command (NEW, lightweight)\n\n#### 5.5b.3 — Periodic Sync-Grilling Hook (S6, ~70K)\n\n**File**: `scripts/hooks/sync-grilling-trigger.sh` (SessionStart hook)\n\n**Behavior**:\n- Read `last_sync_check` from `.session-hooks.log` or sync-state.md\n- If elapsed sessions ≥ `STOCKFORGE_SYNC_GRILL_INTERVAL_SESSIONS` (default 3) OR elapsed days ≥ `STOCKFORGE_SYNC_GRILL_INTERVAL_DAYS` (default 7) → emit notification \"sync-grilling due; agent should fire AskUserQuestion sync-check\"\n- Do NOT auto-fire AskUserQuestion (per UP-05 — Skill/Ask tool autonomous-mode policy: only SUPERVISED mode fires)\n\n**Settings.json wiring**: add to `hooks.SessionStart` array\n\n#### 5.5b.4 — Sync-Specialized Q&A Template (S6, ~80K)\n\n**File**: `.claude/skills/grill-maximization/references/sync-bundle-template.md`\n\n**Differs from feature/scope grill**:\n- Questions phrased as \"do we still understand X the same way?\" not \"what should we do?\"\n- Each question references `sync-state.md` item ID\n- Multi-batch protocol: 4 questions per Ask call\n- Output: updates sync-state.md item states (confirmed/assumed/open transitions)\n\n**Pairs with grill-maximization SKILL.md**: add new section \"Sync Bundle Composition\" pointing to this template.\n\n---\n\n### 5.5c — Self-Capability + Karpathy Autoresearch Full (S7+S8, ~400K)\n\n**Goal**: Build full Karpathy autoresearch loop infrastructure per UP-06 §3.\n\n#### 5.5c.1 — `decompose-work` Skill (S7, ~80K)\n\n**File**: `.claude/skills/decompose-work/SKILL.md` + `references/`\n\n**Mandate**:\n- Input: free-form task description\n- Output: structured analysis\n  - **Deterministic portions**: list of sub-tasks doable via script/hook/code (no LLM judgment)\n  - **LLM-required portions**: sub-tasks requiring reasoning, creativity, judgment\n  - **Integration plan**: how the portions combine (sequence, data flow, escalation rules)\n\n**Reads `capability-map.md`** at decomposition time to ground \"what LLM is good at vs not\".\n\n#### 5.5c.2 — `capability-map.md` (S7, ~40K)\n\n**File**: `agent-workspace/memory/capability-map.md`\n\n**Living document, sparse cells**:\n```yaml\ndimensions:\n  - model: [opus-4.7, sonnet-4.6, haiku-4.5]\n  - effort: [low, medium, high, xhigh, max]\n  - task_class: [refactor, design, verification, extraction, synthesis, calibration, ...]\nstrengths_observed:\n  - {model: opus-4.7, task_class: design, effort: high, observation: \"...\", source: agent-notes-YYYY-MM-DD}\nlimits_observed:\n  - {model: opus-4.7, task_class: math, observation: \"I-S1: NO LLM math; deterministic always\", source: charter}\n```\n\n**Seeded from**:\n- existing agent-notes.md entries (clustered by similar pattern)\n- Track 0 patterns-discovered/SYNTHESIS.md anti-pattern list\n- post-mortems (when they exist)\n\n#### 5.5c.6 — Promotion Path (S7, ~80K)\n\n**File**: `.claude/skills/promote-rule/SKILL.md` (or hybrid hook+agent)\n\n**Mandate**:\n- Periodic: scan `agent-notes.md`; cluster similar entries (semantic similarity ≥0.7)\n- Cluster of ≥3 similar → propose promotion to skill/hook/constitution\n- Priority per Q-E3 (queued-grill-master): hook FIRST, skill SECOND, charter LAST\n- Output: proposal in `agent-workspace/memory/observations/promotion-proposals-<TS>.md`\n\n#### 5.5c.3 — `try-n-approaches` Skill (S8, ~80K)\n\n**File**: `.claude/skills/try-n-approaches/SKILL.md`\n\n**Pattern**:\n- Given a task + N (default 3)\n- Generate N distinct approaches (different framings, tools, decompositions)\n- Dispatch N subagents in parallel (`run_in_background: true`)\n- Each approach has measurement metric defined upfront\n- Compare results → select best → loop-deepen with refined understanding\n\n**Horizontal scaling**: parallel approach exploration\n**Vertical scaling**: loop-deepen the best approach\n\n#### 5.5c.4 — OTEL Stack (S8, ~70K)\n\n**Files**:\n- `docker/otel-stack/docker-compose.yml` (single-container `grafana/otel-lgtm:1.4.0` per Q-S4 confirm)\n- `docker/otel-stack/otel-collector-config.yaml`\n- `packages/observability/otel_emitter.py` (instrumented Python emitter)\n\n**Per D-002 REV-2 § amendment**: 3 files copy-verbatim from orch reference; adapt env var prefix.\n\n**Smoke-test**: `docker-compose up` → emit sample trace from Python → verify in collector.\n\n#### 5.5c.5 — JSONL Telemetry Schema Extension (S8, ~50K)\n\n**File**: extend `scripts/hooks/component-telemetry.sh`\n\n**Schema additions**:\n```jsonl\n{\"event\": \"task_decompose\", \"task_id\": \"...\", \"approach_count\": 3, \"task_class\": \"...\"}\n{\"event\": \"approach_metric\", \"task_id\": \"...\", \"approach_id\": \"...\", \"metric\": \"tokens_used\", \"value\": 12340}\n{\"event\": \"approach_outcome\", \"task_id\": \"...\", \"approach_id\": \"...\", \"outcome\": \"succeeded|failed|partial\", \"evidence\": \"...\"}\n```\n\n**Schema doc**: `agent-workspace/memory/self-awareness/jsonl-schema.md`\n\n---\n\n## After Track 5.5 → S9 = Track 6
